== Summary ==
[[Nate Meeker]] plays an opponent named Hollingsworth in the Sunday fun event at the [[2008 Match Play Championship]], January 2008. Meeker’s Flickr caption: "Me vs Hollingsworth in the sunday fun event".

== Source ==
Photo by Nate Meeker, Flickr: [https://www.flickr.com/photos/53301220@N00/2174691034/ DSCN0095] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2015/2174691034_c1c4cfd0a5_b.jpg). Album linked in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=254001#p254001 post by Meeker] (Nate Meeker), "Nate Meeker PICTURES!", Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 7 January 2008, linking his Flickr album "MPC 2008 GG". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005855/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t18290.html Internet Archive]
